turns.prompt: Tweak the snow globe. Make the globe and the unicorn bigger, leave the base as is. Should change the perspective on the globe a bit, should look at if from a bit diagonally above if settled. Drop the flat mode
turns.reply:
I've made the globe and the unicorn bigger, given it a slightly-from-above view, and removed FLAT mode. It's pushed in PR https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/104.

- **Bigger:** the glass radius goes from 36 to 44 px. The unicorn, its mane and tail, and the snow mound grow by the same amount (about a fifth). The base is the same size; it just sits a bit lower so the glass still rests in its rim. I also raised the glitter from 240 to 340 flakes so the bigger glass doesn't look emptier.
- **Perspective:** the camera now looks down at a slight angle (`pitch: 0.35` rad, about 20°, in `src/config.js`). Once the globe settles you see the top of the snow and the base's rim. Grabbing, turning and shaking work as before. The picture area grows to 152 px so the base still fits however the globe is turned.
- **FLAT mode removed:** the switch button, the F key, the old flat picture (`assets/arcade/globe-big.png`) and its code are gone. The small globe in the hall is unchanged.

The design doc and its decision log are updated. I checked a settled frame in a headless phone-size browser with no console errors, and saved that screenshot to the making-of page.

On the phone: open LOOK CLOSER on the snow globe, let it settle and check that the angle from above looks right. Then turn it hard and flip it over to make sure the base never gets cut off. If the angle is too much or too little, it's the one `pitch` number.

Plan usage is at 32% (5-hour) and 40% (weekly).

turns.prompt: Make the globe bigger, the stand flatter. Make the manr thicker, and make sure the simulated hair doesnt clip into the body. Change the color of the floor in the globe to a green meadow. Add a fluffy cloud overhead. Add the note on the bottom of the stand
turns.reply:
I've made all the globe changes and put them in a new PR, https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/108, because #104 was already merged. I checked both a resting and a tipped-over globe in a headless phone-size browser.

- **Bigger globe, flatter stand:** the glass radius goes from 44 to 52 px. The unicorn stays the same size, since you only asked for the globe this time. The stand is as wide as before but half as tall.
- **Thicker hair, no clipping:** the mane and tail are about 60% thicker. They now bump against the unicorn's body instead of passing through it, and their resting shape no longer overlaps it either. In a 10-second shaking test no hair went into the body.
- **Meadow and cloud:** the floor is a green meadow hill, and the small globe in the hall is green too. A fluffy cloud sits fixed overhead at the upper left, behind the horn.
- **The note:** "MY SISTER LOVED THIS ONE AS A KID." is now on a small paper taped to the bottom of the stand. You read it by tipping the globe so its bottom faces you; if you flip it straight upside down you see the bottom almost edge-on and the note doesn't show. Max can redraw it as its own image, `assets/arcade/globe-note.png`.

I picked the cloud's position and put the note only on the underside; both are logged in the design doc and easy to change. Screenshots of both views are on the making-of page.

**To test on the phone:** open LOOK CLOSER, shake the globe hard and watch whether the mane and tail ever go into the body. Then drag the bottom toward you until the note is readable.

Plan usage is at 51% (5-hour) and 45% (weekly).
